name: Stereo Garden

evidence.note: Official site: former roller rink with over 20,000 sq ft of open, column-free floor; 21+ unless stated.
Club 30+ on Sat Oct 3, 5-9 pm: club-style party with DJs, disco balls and confetti.
Listing describes three bars, a full stage, a dance floor and a VIP area.

dancing.notes: The old roller-rink floor gives lots of open space in front of the stage. Club 30+ is a daytime club party with DJs playing 80s, 90s and 2000s hits, made for dancing.

description: A large multi-use music venue and event hall in Patchogue village, built as a 1940s roller rink, with a stage, two bars, multiple levels and a beer garden.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Phone numbers differ: the website shows (631) 416-7755, while Bing lists (631) 699-8151 (the events/brunch contact). Club 30+ is a touring party brand run by an outside promoter, ticketed, 21+.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The site shows three phone numbers: (631) 699-8151 as the main PHONE on the contact page (also on Bing; same number given for brunch bookings), (631) 416-7755 in the 'have your next event with us' block (our current value), and (631) 714-4486 in the footer and structured data. We used 699-8151; owner may prefer another. A related page 'Stereo Garden Banquets' (stereogardenbanquets.com, facebook.com/StereoGardenBanquets) exists for catering; not recorded. A good concert photo on the site (_DSC8977) was skipped because the crowd looks young and may include minors. No exterior photo on the site. Age rule: 21+ unless the event says otherwise.
hours: Thu-Sat 3 PM-2 AM; Sun 12 PM-12 AM; closed Mon-Wed (show times vary)

logo.alt: Stereo Garden logo: white lettering on a black guitar-pick shape reading Kitchen, Tap, Stage, Stereo Garden, Patchogue N.Y.

photos.alt: Black and white photo of the big Stereo Garden hall: a long bar, chandeliers under arched wooden rafters and a wide open wood floor
Sepia photo of a Stereo Garden bar with a white counter, leather bar stools, round hanging lamps and long tables
Tall pink tufted leather booths in the Stereo Garden lounge, with a large black and white mural of musicians on the wall

evidence.note: Contact page lists 9 Railroad Avenue, Patchogue, NY 11772, phone (631) 699-8151, info@stereogardenli.com and weekly hours (Thu-Sat 3 PM-2 AM, Sun noon-midnight).

Home page says the building was the Patchogue Roller Rink in the 1940s, has over 20,000 sq ft of open floor, a stage seen from several levels and two bars; 21+ unless an event says otherwise; dress code.
About page repeats the multi-purpose venue description and shows the lounge and hall photos.
